question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'rushed'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The title of the given passage is 'Greedy Man'.
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is 'rushed'.
 
• The given sentence is in the** simple past tense **so the verb must be used in its **past form(V₂).**
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

Correct Passage:__ *T**he greedy man rushed home to tell his wife and daughter about his wish, all the while touching the objects in his path and watching them convert into gold. Once he got home, his daughter **rushed** to greet him. As soon as he bent (4) ______ to scoop her up in his arms, she turned into a golden statue. He was (5) _____ and started crying and trying to bring his daughter back to life.*
